meta.title: GenAI at work — validation of the extraction
meta.tagline: The pipeline's record of each paper checked by coders in three tasks over the one record: a blind judgment of design and units by two coders, one exhibit's cells against the print, every routed flag resolved.
meta.description: One workflow over one dataset — the pipeline's record of every paper, uploaded as an import file with the PDF (the quoted passages highlighted) — and three review tasks over it, each a review template the coders work through, answering its questions into their own coding. Judgment: the study's screening and design from the PDF alone, the units as extracted (tasks, arms, outcomes, subgroups, horizons) with the coder's categories, the abstract's sentences against their units — two coders per paper, blind to the model's categories and to the numbers. Extraction check: one exhibit per paper drawn at random among those the estimates cite, every cited cell as printed against its unit, misses added, a full-review flag. Routed papers: a paper whose record contradicts an inclusion criterion, whose headline estimate scores high on the checks, or that a coder flagged — every flag resolved. The record is checked by the pipeline's deterministic rules on arrival and by its contract after the coding. The people are added to the project; each task assigns its papers to them; the release waits for every assigned verdict.

authors.affiliation: University of Basel; University of Copenhagen

steps.label: Extraction record
steps.help: the pipeline's record of the paper — the tasks with their arms and outcomes, one reference row and one contrast row per estimate with the numbers as printed, the claims of its text, its exhibits with their transcribed cells, the flags its checks raised and its routing — uploaded with the PDF; the one dataset the three tasks read

steps.label: Record checks
steps.help: the pipeline's deterministic checks over the record as stored: structure, plausibility and scale, statistics within the rounding, SD vs SE, duplicates, numbers against their quotes; findings are notes on the records, the routing stays the pipeline's

steps.label: Judgment
steps.help: the study's screening and design from the PDF alone, the units as extracted with the coder's categories, the abstract's sentences against their units; two coders per paper, each blind to the other and to the model's categories

steps.label: Extraction check
steps.help: one exhibit per paper, drawn at random among those an estimate cites: every cited cell as printed against its unit, the cells the extraction missed added, a full-review flag

steps.label: Routed papers
steps.help: a paper whose record contradicts an inclusion criterion, whose headline estimate scores high on the checks, or that a coder flagged: every flag resolved

steps.label: Contract check
steps.help: the declared fields, types and options of the record re-checked on the values as stored, after the coders' corrections; findings are notes on the records, never a verdict
